summary: Both 3.10 findings are confirmed by code reading and map cleanly onto the repro tests. (1) Reader-pool starvation: develop's TxnManager (GH-5970) admits at most 127 ordinary read leases plus one reserved slot with a 30 s admission timeout; every default SPARQL evaluation already holds two ordinary leases (UnionSailSource opens an explicit and an inferred LmdbSailDataset, each createReadTxn), and branch-added planner code then takes further ordinary leases on the same thread (TripleStore.repeatedVariableCardinality/exactCardinality/sampleTriplesStratified/boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality/indexCostProfile, LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator 131/173/369, LmdbFilterSelectivityStats 685/777/1342). The root cause is that planner-time storage reads are not bound to the query's own snapshot lease; the fix is a pinned planning read lease: the pipeline hands the dataset's Txn into the estimator optimization scope and every planner-time read goes through TripleStore.planningReadTxn()/planningRead(), which reuses the pinned txn (no permit) and only falls back to a fresh lease when no pin exists; the 369 self-deadlock disappears because nested reads share the pin. A second, independently landable part caps the unbounded exact scans (repeatedVariableCardinality, exactCardinality) so no planner read is ever both unbounded and lease-holding. (2) Sampled finite probes labelled DATABASE_EXACT: since the merge, TripleStore.planningCardinality delegates to develop's bounded page estimator and throws away its CardinalityEstimate.exact/hard-bound fields; LmdbPackedCostModel:386-388 nevertheless stamps every finite_binding_probe row as DATABASE_EXACT, so a sampled 0 becomes EXACT_ZERO (evidenceSummary -> EvidenceStateSummary.exact), certifies root rows, classifies memo states as exact-extensional, marks prefixes provably empty (EstimateContext:145) and excludes the operator from LEO learning. The fix carries exactness and hard bounds from the estimator through LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource and LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess into FiniteLookupEstimate, labels DATABASE_EXACT only when every probe was exact, otherwise CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY/SCALAR_FALLBACK with bound metrics, and escalates non-exact zeros to a key-bounded exact probe on the pinned txn (roadmap 4.3 fallback chain).

findings.title: Planner-time nested ordinary read leases starve on develop's fixed LMDB reader pool (pinned planning read lease)
findings.severity: S2 (merge-integration; 30-60 s stalls per query under >=63 concurrent includeInferred queries, then silently lost estimates)
findings.rootCause: Pool: core/sail/lmdb/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/TxnManager.java L82-100 (POOL_SIZE=128, readerSlots=Semaphore(127), priorityReaderSlot=Semaphore(1), READER_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT_NANOS=30 s), L318-337 acquireReaderPermit throws IOException after 30 s; only doWithPriority (L224-226) may use the reserved slot and its javadoc requires the callback to not acquire another read txn. Leases held by a query: core/sail/base/.../SailSourceConnection.java L265-280 evaluateInternal -> branch(IncludeInferred) L1155-1187 -> UnionSailSource(inferred, explicit) for includeInferred=true -> UnionSailSource.dataset L83-90 opens two datasets -> LmdbSailStore.java L3286-3300 LmdbSailDataset ctor createReadTxn() (tracked) => two ordinary permits per default query, held through optimize() (L280) and evaluation. Nested ordinary acquisitions during planning on the same thread (all branch-added): TripleStore.java L1810 repeatedVariableCardinality (createReadTxn, unbounded scan) <- LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.java L298 estimateRepeatedIds <- L233 estimateForPlanning(repeatedMask) <- LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java L110-114 legacyPackedRows <- LmdbPackedCostModel.java L240 statementPatternRows / L3598 finiteProbeRows; TripleStore.java L2106 exactCardinality (doWith = ordinary createReadTxnInternal(true,false), unbounded) <- LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource L99 estimateExact <- LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.java L272 exactCandidate; TripleStore.java L1506 sampleTriplesStratified (doWith) <- LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.java L1301 <- L1259 sampleFilterPassRatio <- L610 estimateLiveFilterPass (foreground planning); on IOException the fallback at L1342 takes ANOTHER ordinary createReadTxn (second 30 s wait) before returning null; TripleStore.java L1419 boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality (createReadTxn) <- LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource L144-146 <- LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess L160; TripleStore.java L2157 indexCostProfile (doWith) <- LmdbPhysicalCostObjective.java L79 loadProfile (per-session cache only; first use per query is a nested ordinary lease — not listed by the review); LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator.java L131 estimateAlternative, L173 estimateConnected, L369 estimate (createReadTxn); L369 nests: inside its txn it calls exactSeedIndex (L379) / surfaceCardinality (L403) -> planningCardinality(ids, scanBudget) L606-618 -> cardinalities.estimateIdsForPlanning -> TripleStore.planningCardinality L1801 -> cardinality L1754 -> cardinalityUsingPageEstimator L1874 doWithPriority (or legacy sampler L1944/L1957 doWithPriority). Converting L369 to doWithPriority would make the nested doWithPriority wait on the single reserved permit held by the same thread -> 30 s self-deadlock (confirmed). LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.java L685 exactBoundedFilterZero, L777 exactMatchingDistinctValues also createReadTxn. All these callers swallow the IOException (LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource returns -1/OptionalDouble.empty; LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator returns Optional.empty; sampleFilterPassRatio returns null), so after the timeout the estimate is silently lost. develop's own nested estimator sites were moved to doWithPriority (TripleStore L1874/L1944/L1957) and develop's filter sampler has exactly one ordinary site (develop LmdbFilterSelectivityStats L538); the branch added the rest.
findings.fix: Bind every planner-time storage read to the query's own snapshot lease instead of acquiring new leases (roadmap 4.2 snapshot binding + 4.6 fail-safe): (a) TripleStore gets a pinned planning lease: `AutoCloseable pinPlanningTxn(Txn pinned)` (ThreadLocal<Txn> in TripleStore, depth-counted; cleared on close) plus two accessors used by ALL planner-time reads: `Txn planningReadTxn()` returns a non-owning view of the pinned txn when present (close() is a no-op; keep the real Txn object so LmdbRecordIterator still gets version()/lockManager()/valuePool — do not wrap via createTxn(long)), otherwise `txnManager.createReadTxn()` (the thread holds no dataset lease in that case, so an ordinary permit is correct and cannot nest); `<T> T planningRead(Transaction<T>)` runs the callback on `pinned.get()` under `lockManager.readLock()` exactly like TxnManager.doWith does, else falls back to the existing `doWithPriority` (short, bounded, non-nesting callbacks only). (b) Convert the TripleStore sites: cardinalityUsingPageEstimator L1874 and the legacy sampler L1944/L1957 -> planningRead (pinned first, priority fallback = current develop behaviour); sampleTriplesStratified, repeatedVariableCardinality, exactCardinality, boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality, indexCostProfile -> take an explicit `Txn` parameter and let callers obtain it from planningReadTxn() (explicit passing; no policy inside). (c) Convert the estimator sites: LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator L131/L173/L369 and LmdbFilterSelectivityStats L685/L777/L1342 replace `tripleStore.getTxnManager().createReadTxn()` with `tripleStore.planningReadTxn()`; sampleFilterPassRatio opens one txn at the top and passes it to sampleTriplesStratified and the prefix fallback (removes the double 30 s wait). With a pin present the nested planningCardinality inside L369 reuses the same txn, so no permit is taken at any depth and the self-deadlock is structurally impossible. (d) Establish the pin per query: LmdbEstimatorRuntime.beginScope(Txn pinned) stores the txn in LmdbEstimatorOptimizationScope and calls tripleStore.pinPlanningTxn for the outermost scope (closeScope unpins); LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.optimize/computePlan opens the scope for the whole pipeline (so non-cascades optimizers that call LmdbEvaluationFilterServices/filter stats are covered) and LmdbCascadesOptimizer.beginQueryOptimizationScope just nests; LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh passes its LmdbDetachedPlanningSnapshot dataset's txn the same way. (e) Reaching the dataset Txn from the pipeline: LMDB-internal `interface LmdbPinnedReadTxnSource { Optional<Txn> pinnedReadTxn(); }` implemented by LmdbSailDataset (returns txn unless closed). The pipeline only has a SailDatasetTripleTermSource, whose dataset may be an LmdbSailDataset, a UnionSailDataset (inferred+explicit) or a SailDatasetImpl/DelegatingSailDataset wrapper; add to sail-base `SailDataset` a capability lookup `default <T> Optional<T> unwrap(Class<T> type)` (self if instance, else empty), overridden in UnionSailDataset (dataset1 then dataset2), DelegatingSailDataset (delegate) and SailDatasetImpl (derivedFrom), plus `SailDatasetTripleTermSource.unwrapDataset(Class<T>)`. This mirrors the getSnapshotEpoch() plumbing this branch already added to sail-base. For the union case pin the explicit dataset's txn (either sees both explicit and inferred DBs). Alternative if sail-base must not change: tag Txn with its owner thread and creation sequence in TxnManager and let TripleStore.pinPlanningTxn default to `txnManager.newestTxnHeldByCurrentThread()` — implicit and picks the wrong snapshot when a thread holds an unrelated untracked txn, so only as a fallback option. (f) Fail-safe: planningReadTxn/planningRead never throw for a missing pin; if the pinned txn was closed concurrently (LmdbSailDataset.close from another thread) fall back to the unpinned path. Why sound: the pinned txn is the execution dataset's tracked txn; LMDB read txns are single-threaded and planning runs on the query thread before evaluation opens iterators; TxnManager.reset()/deactivate() run under the write lock while every planning read holds the read lock (same discipline as doWith and LmdbRecordIterator), so a concurrent commit cannot reset the handle mid-read. Estimates now read the execution snapshot (the review's stated bonus).

findings.risk: Medium. Concurrency-adjacent (lease accounting) but strictly reduces permit usage; the main hazards are (1) a stale pin (ThreadLocal not cleared) making a later query on the same thread read a closed txn — mitigated by depth-counted pin/unpin in try/finally and a closed-check fallback; (2) planning now reads the pinned snapshot: for tracked query datasets this is what execution sees anyway; for the untracked detached-refresh snapshot estimates stop seeing rows committed after the snapshot (intended per LmdbDetachedPlanningSnapshot.snapshotEpoch but a behaviour change for wp5/3.3 caches); (3) sail-base API addition (default method, source-compatible). No public LMDB API change; japicmp unaffected except the new default method on SailDataset (additive).
findings.recommendationReason: Merge-induced S2 that turns every planner estimate into a 30-60 s stall under realistic concurrency and then silently degrades plans; the design removes the nesting rather than widening the reserved slot, and it is a prerequisite for making estimates snapshot-consistent (roadmap 4.2).

findings.title: Cap the unbounded planner scans (repeatedVariableCardinality, exactCardinality) so no planning read is both unbounded and lease-holding
findings.severity: S2 companion (latency + lease hold time; also blocks the reserved slot whenever the priority fallback is used)
findings.rootCause: TripleStore.java L1806-1823 repeatedVariableCardinality iterates every row of the unrepeated pattern on both planes (for `?s :p ?s` that is all :p rows) and TripleStore.java L2105-2118 exactCardinality iterates all matching rows; both are called at planning time (LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.java L99-100 estimateExact, L298 estimateRepeatedIds; reached from LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.legacyPackedRows L110-114 for the packed cost model and LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactCandidate L272 for the engine when frontier statistics are OFF). The only budget is the query-wide SHARED_*_CACHE keyed by dataRevision. The review explicitly asks to cap them; without a cap the lease fix in 3.10.1 still lets one planning call hold the pinned snapshot (or, unpinned, the reserved slot) for a full-index scan.
findings.fix: Add row caps with an honest fallback (roadmap 4.3: never collapse unknown to 1 or 0): `repeatedVariableCardinality(Txn, s,p,o,c, mask, long maxScannedRows)` returns a PlanningCardinality record (rows, exact, lowerRows, upperRows): when the scan completes under the cap -> exact count; when the cap is hit -> rows = matches/scanned x planningCardinalityEstimate(unrepeated).entries, clamped to [matches, unrepeatedUpperBound], exact=false, lower=matches, upper=unrepeated hard upper bound (the unrepeated pattern is a certified superset). `exactCardinality(Txn, s,p,o,c, long maxScannedRows)` returns OptionalDouble.empty() when the cap is exceeded; LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateExact then returns -1 (its existing 'unavailable' contract) so LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactCandidate declines and the engine uses its estimated candidates. Cap constant: reuse LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator.MAX_SCANNED_ROWS (4096) as PLANNING_EXACT_SCAN_ROWS in TripleStore, or LmdbStoreConfig.OPTIMIZER_SAMPLING_MAX_ROWS if a config knob is preferred; cache extrapolated results in SHARED_CARDINALITY_CACHE with the exact flag so the cost model can label them (see 3.10.2).

findings.title: Sampled finite_binding_probe cardinalities stamped DATABASE_EXACT (sampled 0 -> EXACT_ZERO; excluded from learning)
findings.severity: S3 as filed; effectively S2 because a sampled zero becomes an exact emptiness certificate that certifies root rows, marks prefixes provably empty and freezes learning
findings.rootCause: LmdbPackedCostModel.java L292-294 finiteLookupEstimate -> L3506-3520 per distinct VALUES row finiteProbeRows -> L3592-3600 runtime.packedStatementPatternRows -> LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java L92-108: frontier AUTHORITATIVE returns statistics.estimateLeafCurrent(probe).pointRows() (a calibrated interval, FrontierLeafEstimate has no exactness), otherwise L110-114 legacyPackedRows -> LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateForPlanning L221-236 -> estimateIds(planning=true) L262-283 -> TripleStore.planningCardinality L1801 -> cardinality L1754-1799 -> cardinalityUsingPageEstimator L1861-1906 which returns CardinalityEstimate.entries() and discards `exact`, `hardLowerBound`, `hardUpperBound` (estimate/LmdbPageCardinalityEstimator.java L125-138; exact is false whenever the range was sampled, see LmdbBtreeRangeCounter L264/L358 result.exact = exhaustive). Pre-merge (git 4354ff137b^1 TripleStore L1645-1656) planningCardinality used HEAD's exhaustive page walk, so the label was true then; develop's GH-6006 bounded estimator made it false (merge origin). Nevertheless LmdbPackedCostModel.java L386-392 does `output.setEstimateFusion("finite_binding_probe"); output.setEvidenceGuarantee(EvidenceGuarantee.DATABASE_EXACT)` unconditionally (while the sibling exact-surface routes at L2352/L2376 correctly gate on SurfaceEstimate.exact()). Consequences: LmdbFrontierStatisticsCostSession.java L367-371 evidenceSummary -> EvidenceStateSummary.exact(pointRows) -> for 0 rows EXACT_ZERO (EvidenceStateSummary L153-163); PackedCascadesPlanner.java L719-724 certifiedRootRows returns the sampled point as certified; PackedEvidenceStateRegistry L43-45 and PackedMemo L1091-1119 classify the state EXACT_EXTENSIONAL (continuation dedup drops provenance); EstimateContext.java L138-147 treats an EXACT_ZERO prefix as provably empty; LmdbPackedCostModel L1420 skips mapped-join refinement for DATABASE_EXACT inputs; LmdbMappedFrontierLearningSession.java L162 skips all LEO corrections for DATABASE_EXACT outputs and L440-441 sets RuntimeFeedbackContract.DATABASE_EXACT so FrontierLearningModel.java L173 and L186 never learn from the operator. The engine-side finite lookup (LmdbEstimationEngine L388-457, LmdbEstimateClassification L27-33) is NOT affected: it derives exactness from BagEstimate.confidence()==1.0.
findings.fix: Carry exactness and hard bounds from the estimator to the label instead of asserting it at the cost model (roadmap 4.3 fallback chain; same pattern as SurfaceEstimate.exact): (1) TripleStore: add `CardinalityEstimate planningCardinalityEstimate(s,p,o,c)` returning the page estimator's CardinalityEstimate (bindingMask==0 -> exact totals; legacy sampler -> CardinalityEstimate.unqualified; combine* already propagates exact=first&&second and hard bounds); keep `planningCardinality` as `.entries()` wrapper for existing callers. (2) LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource: `PlanningCardinality estimateForPlanningQualified(subj,pred,obj,ctx,repeatedMask)` returning record (rows, exact, lowerRows, upperRows); repeatedMask!=0 uses the capped repeatedVariableCardinality from 3.10.1b; cache the record in SHARED_CARDINALITY_CACHE (value type Double -> record). (3) LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRowsQualified: frontier route -> (pointRows, exact=false, lowerRows, upperRows, confidence); legacy route -> the record. (4) LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteLookupEstimate: aggregate exact = AND over distinct probes, lower = sum(lower x frequency), upper = sum(upper x frequency); extend FiniteLookupEstimate (L3758) with exact/lowerRows/upperRows; at L386-392 set DATABASE_EXACT only when exact, otherwise CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY when hard bounds are finite (evidenceSummary L393-395 -> EvidenceStateSummary.certifiedBounds; a zero point yields zeroStatus UNRESOLVED, never EXACT_ZERO) else SCALAR_FALLBACK, and always publish plannedFrontierLowerRows/plannedFrontierUpperRows (already consumed by evidenceSummary via boundedMetric) plus a plannedFiniteProbeExact 0/1 metric for explain output. (5) Zero escalation (unknown != 0): when a probe's estimate is non-exact and entries==0 (or hardLowerBound==0 with hardUpperBound>0), run `TripleStore.boundedExactCardinality(Txn, s,p,o,c, maxScannedKeys)` — a raw-cursor walk over the best index range on the pinned planning txn that counts matcher hits and stops after maxScannedKeys keys examined (bounded in keys, not matches; reuse the cursor code shape of sampleTriplesStratified/cardinalityUsingSamplingEstimator) -> OptionalLong; a present result replaces the probe as exact (0 becomes a legitimate EXACT_ZERO, >0 removes the false zero); an absent result keeps the sampled value and the non-exact label. Finite probes are prefix-bound by construction (a VALUES row binds at least one component), so on spoc/posc/ospc-style index sets the walk is tiny; key cap e.g. 8192. Put the escalation in LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateForPlanningQualified (not in TripleStore.planningCardinality, whose contract is 'never exhaustive'), so the unqualified planningCardinality API keeps develop's semantics.

findings.risk: Low-medium: for small stores the page estimator is exhaustive (exact=true) so nothing changes; for sampled probes the guarantee downgrades, which can change plan choice where the planner previously trusted a false exact zero (that is the intended correction) and re-enables LEO learning for those operators (wp6 interaction). Explain output for finite_binding_probe rows changes guarantee text when sampled. Mockito-based tests stubbing planningCardinality need new stubs.
findings.recommendationReason: A sampled zero currently becomes a database-exact emptiness proof that certifies root rows and marks prefixes provably empty; correcting the label is small, local, and unblocks 3.10.1b's non-exact extrapolations from being mislabelled as exact.
